Annotation Interface Nullable

@Documented @Target({FIELD,METHOD,PARAMETER,LOCAL_VARIABLE,TYPE_PARAMETER,TYPE_USE}) @Retention(CLASS) public @interface Nullable
Indicates that a field/parameter/variable/type parameter/return type may be null.
